name: Storytelling
prompts: Did the story pull you in?
Did the intro name the story?

tags.label: Storytelling
tags.strength: You told the story in a way that pulled me in.
tags.toWork: Build the story toward its high point more clearly.

tags.label: Characters
tags.strength: Each character was clear and different.
tags.toWork: Make each character more different in voice and body.

tags.label: Energy
tags.strength: Your energy kept the story alive.
tags.toWork: Bring more energy to keep the story moving.

tags.label: Pacing
tags.strength: Your pacing gave key moments room to land.
tags.toWork: Slow down at key moments so they have room to land.

tags.label: Intro
tags.strength: Your intro set up the piece well and named the title and author.
tags.toWork: Use the intro to set up the piece and name the title and author.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
